prompt_package.style_lock: Western medieval fantasy illustrated in expressive Japanese sumi-e on warm handmade washi. Black and charcoal-gray ink washes, feathered edges, irregular dry-brush contours, layered atmospheric distance and generous unpainted paper. Distinct silhouettes for tower, village, bridge, forest, river, shop and relic. Sparse muted vermilion only for danger, rivals, seals or meaningful focus. Map, town, forge, event and UI feel drawn on the same page; compact readable annotation-like controls. Not a simple sepia filter on clean vector graphics.
